boundaries.note: Common British spelling of the same noun.

ops.en: a person who questions, doubts, or is not readily convinced by claims, accepted beliefs, or supposed facts
ops.cn: 怀疑者；对主张、普遍接受的信念或所谓事实持质疑态度的人

ops.value: skeptic/sceptic concerns doubt or questioning; agnostic concerns claimed uncertainty or unknowability, especially about God. Do not merge the concepts.

ops.en: to use, spend, provide, or do less than is needed, often producing an inadequate result
ops.cn: 少给；少用；少花；敷衍做，导致不足或质量不够

ops.meaning_cn: 在某物上过分节省、投入不足或做得不充分

ops.en: insufficient, scanty, or too small in amount, size, or coverage; of clothing, revealing more of the body than usual
ops.cn: 不足的；过少的；尺寸或覆盖太小的；（衣服）过于暴露的

ops.en: to rise, increase, or grow extremely rapidly
ops.cn: 猛涨；激增；极快上升或增长

ops.en: a type of firework that shoots high into the sky before exploding or displaying light
ops.cn: 高空烟花；升空后爆炸或发光的烟火

ops.en: to become less tight, intense, fast, active, or demanding
ops.cn: 放松；减弱；放慢；变得不那么紧张、强烈或活跃

ops.en: to make something less tight, intense, fast, active, or demanding
ops.cn: 使放松；使减弱；使放慢；降低强度或活跃程度

ops.en: the waste or scum separated from metal during smelting or other high-temperature processing
ops.cn: 炉渣；金属冶炼或高温处理时分离出的废渣

ops.cn: 形成炉渣；使变成炉渣

ops.en: to satisfy or quench a thirst, desire, or need, or more generally reduce its intensity
ops.cn: 解渴；满足欲望或需要；减弱强烈感受

ops.en: to cut with a forceful sweeping stroke of a knife, blade, or other sharp tool
ops.cn: 挥砍；用刀刃等锋利工具大力横向切割

ops.en: a forceful sweeping cut made with a sharp instrument
ops.cn: 挥砍；用锋利器具划出的深切口

ops.en: figurative: to reduce a price, budget, number, or amount sharply
ops.cn: （比喻）大幅削减价格、预算、数量或金额

ops.en: the punctuation mark /
ops.cn: 斜杠符号 /

ops.en: smooth, glossy, well-groomed, or streamlined and elegant in shape or appearance
ops.cn: 光滑有光泽的；整洁漂亮的；线条流畅、造型优雅的

ops.en: to hit someone or something sharply, especially with an open hand
ops.cn: 掌掴；啪地击打；尤指用张开的手猛击

ops.cn: 掌掴；啪的一击；尤指用手掌猛击

ops.meaning_cn: 明显带有、让人强烈感觉到某种不好的性质或意味
ops.definition_en: to strongly suggest or have a noticeable trace of something

ops.note: Noun: a loud or enthusiastic kiss; secondary use.

ops.en: to spread a substance messily over a surface, or leave a dirty or blurred mark on it
ops.cn: 涂抹；弄脏；把物质抹开或留下污迹、模糊痕迹

ops.en: figurative: to damage someone's reputation by spreading false, hostile, or misleading accusations
ops.cn: （比喻）抹黑；用虚假、恶意或误导性指控损害名誉

ops.en: a false or hostile accusation intended to damage someone's reputation
ops.cn: 抹黑；旨在损害名誉的虚假或恶意指控

ops.en: to deprive someone or something of air or oxygen so that breathing or burning stops
ops.cn: 使窒息；使缺氧；阻止呼吸或燃烧

ops.cn: 完全覆盖、包住；（比喻）压制、扼杀、扑灭

ops.en: excessively self-satisfied, complacent, or pleased with one's own success or correctness
ops.cn: 自鸣得意的；自满的；对自己的成功或正确性过分满足的

ops.value: Historical neat/smart senses are reference-only and must not enter modern learner Core.

ops.en: an unexpected problem, difficulty, or obstacle that delays or complicates progress
ops.cn: 意外障碍；突然出现的问题或困难

ops.cn: 钩住；绊住；被尖锐物或障碍挂住

ops.cn: （非正式）迅速弄到、抢到或抓住某物

ops.cn: 龇牙低吼；发出凶狠的咆哮声

ops.en: the projecting nose and mouth area of an animal's head
ops.cn: 动物的口鼻部；突出的鼻吻部

ops.en: a beaklike projecting part at the front of the head of some insects
ops.cn: 某些昆虫头部前方突出的喙状部分

ops.en: comfortably warm, cozy, sheltered, and pleasant
ops.cn: 温暖舒适的；惬意的；避风而安稳的

ops.en: fitting closely, neatly, or securely
ops.cn: 贴身合适的；紧密合身的；稳妥贴合的

ops.en: safe, sheltered, and well protected
ops.cn: 安全隐蔽的；受到良好保护的

ops.en: the state of being alone, often peacefully or by choice
ops.cn: 独处；独自一人的状态，常可为中性、平静或主动选择

ops.cn: 社会隔离；与他人分离的状态

ops.en: a quiet, isolated, or solitary place
ops.cn: 僻静处；独处之地

ops.en: to calm, comfort, or relieve pain, distress, irritation, or anxiety
ops.cn: 安慰；使平静；缓解疼痛、不适、烦躁或焦虑

ops.value: Low-value historical flatter/cajole material is reference-only and must not enter modern soothe Core.

ops.en: figurative: to cause, generate, or produce new things, effects, problems, or developments, often in large numbers

ops.en: to lay or release eggs, especially of fish, amphibians, or aquatic animals

ops.en: figurative: lacking courage, resolve, firmness, or strength of character
ops.cn: （比喻）软弱的；没骨气的；缺乏勇气或决断力的

ops.en: biology: lacking spines or spine-like projections
ops.cn: （生物学）无刺的；没有棘状突起的

ops.en: having spines, thorns, or sharp projections
ops.cn: 有刺的；有棘的；带尖锐突起的

ops.en: figurative: difficult, troublesome, sensitive, or thorny to deal with
ops.cn: （比喻）棘手的；难处理的；敏感麻烦的

boundaries.note: Common British spelling of the same noun.

ops.en: magnificence, grandeur, beauty, or impressive richness
ops.cn: 壮丽；辉煌；宏伟；令人赞叹的华美

ops.en: exceptional brilliance, excellence, or impressive quality
ops.cn: 非凡的光彩、卓越或出众品质

ops.en: a small, thin, sharp fragment of wood, glass, metal, or another material
ops.cn: 碎片；木头、玻璃、金属等产生的细小尖锐片

ops.cn: 裂成碎片；分裂成细小尖片或小块

ops.cn: （比喻）分裂成派别；团体裂变为多个小群体

ops.meaning_cn: 从较大组织中分裂出来的小派别、分裂团体

ops.en: an opening, tube, or projecting part through which liquid or grain flows out
ops.cn: 喷口；壶嘴；液体或颗粒流出的管口、突出部

ops.en: to gush, jet, or project liquid forcefully
ops.cn: 喷出；涌出；使液体强力喷射

ops.en: figurative/informal: to speak at length or emphatically, often repeating opinions or nonsense
ops.cn: （比喻/非正式）滔滔不绝地说；高谈阔论，常指反复说观点或胡话

ops.en: to spread or extend in an irregular, uncontrolled, or sprawling way over a wide area
ops.cn: 蔓延；无规则地向大片区域扩展

ops.en: irregular, uncontrolled spread over a wide area, especially the outward growth of a city
ops.cn: 无序蔓延；尤指城市向外无规划扩张（urban sprawl）

ops.en: to sit or lie with arms and legs spread out loosely
ops.cn: 四肢摊开地坐或躺；懒散伸展

ops.cn: 四肢摊开的懒散姿势

ops.en: to run or move at maximum or very high speed for a short distance or period
ops.cn: 冲刺；短距离快速奔跑或高速行动

ops.en: a short, fast race or a brief burst of intense activity
ops.cn: 短跑；冲刺；短时间内的高强度行动

ops.en: to gush, jet, or shoot out suddenly in a brief stream
ops.cn: 喷射；突然短促地涌出或射出

ops.cn: 突然的一阵；喷发；活动、增长、速度或产出的短时激增

ops.en: to waste money, time, talent, opportunities, or resources carelessly or thoughtlessly
ops.cn: 挥霍；浪费金钱、时间、才能、机会或资源

ops.cn: 挥霍；奢侈而浪费地花费金钱或资源

ops.en: a short, sharp, high-pitched sound
ops.cn: 吱的一声；短促尖细的高音

ops.cn: 发出吱吱的尖细短声

ops.en: informal: to succeed, pass, or get through only narrowly
ops.cn: （非正式）勉强成功、通过或脱险

ops.meaning_cn: 勉强通过、险胜或擦边成功

ops.en: physical or mental endurance and sustained energy that allows continued effort
ops.cn: 耐力；体力或心理上持续坚持、维持努力的能力和能量

ops.en: severe, harsh, plain, or sharply obvious and impossible to ignore
ops.cn: 严酷的；赤裸明显的；鲜明到无法忽视的

ops.en: complete, absolute, or extreme
ops.cn: 完全的；彻底的；极端的

ops.en: completely or utterly
ops.cn: 完全地；彻底地

ops.meaning_cn: 鲜明的对比；严酷而明显的现实/差异

ops.en: dignified, impressive, majestic, and measured in appearance, movement, or scale
ops.cn: 庄严的；宏伟的；气度不凡而从容的

ops.en: the level of respect, importance, reputation, or standing a person or thing has gained
ops.cn: 声望；地位；重要性；因成就或表现获得的社会评价

ops.cn: 身高；站立时从头到脚的高度

boundaries.note: Staunch is the ordinary adjective meaning loyal/firm and can also spell the flow-stopping verb.
Stanch is a spelling variant of the verb meaning stop a flow; it is not a variant of the loyal adjective.

ops.en: loyal, firm, dependable, and strongly committed in support or belief
ops.cn: 忠诚坚定的；可靠的；坚定支持某人或信念的

ops.cn: 止住；阻止血液或其他液体流出
